basic_details.scholarship_name: Asian Development Bank - Japan Scholarship Program (ADB-JSP)
basic_details.offering_entity: Asian Development Bank (ADB) & Government of Japan
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: 25 designated institutions in 9 countries (University of Tokyo, Kyoto University, Tokyo Tech, Hitotsubashi, NUS, University of Melbourne, University of Auckland, AIM Philippines)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Development-related fields: Economics, Management, Science and Technology, Environment, Agriculture, Public Health, Infrastructure, International Development.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~135 to 150 scholarships awarded annually across 25 institutions
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as an ADB borrowing member country (~10 to 15 Pakistani professionals selected annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 1 to 2 academic years (covering full master's program)

nationality_requirements: Citizen of an ADB borrowing member country (Pakistani citizens eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Not more than 35 years old at the time of application (in exceptional cases, for senior programs, up to 45 years old).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 16 years of education (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) with superior academic record.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.20 / 4.00 CGPA or equivalent top 15% class standing.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Academic background aligned with development-oriented master's courses.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Employed professional with minimum 2 years of full-time professional working experience.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: MANDATORY: At least 2 years of full-time professional working experience acquired after university graduation in a relevant field.

english_proficiency.notes: Proficiency in oral and written English (IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+ satisfying host institution admission standards).

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; all designated ADB-JSP programs taught in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; women and applicants from public sector actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Development impact and mandatory agreement to return to Pakistan for at least 2 years post-graduation.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Ineligible if already holding a Master's degree or currently studying abroad.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition and academic fees at the designated host institution.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly subsistence allowance covering housing, food, and daily living costs (e.g. ~¥147,000/month in Japan).
monthly_stipend.amount: ¥147,000 / month in Japan (~PKR 275,000 / month) or local currency equivalent

airfare.details: Economy class return airfare between home country and the host institution.

visa_fee.details: Student visa fees paid by student.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive medical and accident insurance covered.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Books and instructional materials allowance provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Special grant available for thesis preparation, field trips, and computer software.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Apply to one of the 25 designated academic institutions in the Asia-Pacific region.
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier universities in Japan and the Asia-Pacific region.
available_majors: Economics, Public Policy, International Development, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Urban Planning, Agricultural Economics, Renewable Energy, Public Health, Business Administration
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Apply directly to the designated academic institution for both admission and the ADB-JSP scholarship (at least 6 months before intended intake).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: University of Tokyo (Department of Civil Engineering) and Hitotsubashi University are premier ADB-JSP hubs.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus heavily on how the master's degree aligns with ADB's Strategy 2030 and Pakistan's socio-economic development priorities.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Host Institution Application System (e.g. UTokyo, Kyoto, NUS)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Applicants must request information and application forms directly from the designated institution of their choice, not from ADB.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Choose eligible Master's course from the 25 designated ADB-JSP institutions.
2. Apply for admission and the ADB-JSP scholarship directly to the chosen institution.
3. Submit academic transcripts, proof of 2 years work experience, income tax return, and CV.
4. Host institution screens applicants and conducts academic review.
5. Host institution ranks candidates and submits shortlisted roster to the Asian Development Bank.
6. ADB reviews submissions and selects awardees in coordination with the Government of Japan.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Institutional application: Submitted directly to the designated university.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters (one academic, one employer) submitted to host university.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Address your career progression, development impact goals, and how the program aligns with Pakistan's development.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Master's study plan or research proposal detailing intended focus area.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed professional CV documenting minimum 2 years full-time employment history.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Host university admissions committee conducts video interviews in spring.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: Varies by institution; some waive fees for ADB-JSP.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official ADB-JSP form completed and signed
Official certificate of employment verifying full-time work acquired after graduation
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On employer letterhead with contact info

required_documents_checklist.specification: Salary certificate, FBR tax return, or pay slips of applicant and parents/spouse
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: FBR tax returns or official salary slips

required_documents_checklist.specification: One academic reference and one supervisor reference

important_dates_timeline.semester_commencement: September/October 2027 (or April 2027 for Spring intake in Japan)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Deadlines vary by designated institution (typically between December and February for Fall intake).

selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 25% (At least 2 years full-time experience in development sectors)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Commitment to return and contribute to home country development)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: Preferences given to applicants with lower financial capacity
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Designated institution selection boards and the Asian Development Bank Central Selection Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier review: Academic institution ranks applicants based on academic and professional merit; ADB finalizes selection.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Mid-career professionals with 3 to 6 years of experience in government departments, civil engineering consultancies, or financial institutions.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani civil servants, engineers in infrastructure/power departments, central bank analysts, environmental specialists.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka.

fake_websites_and_scams: Websites claiming to accept direct applications to ADB; ADB does NOT accept direct applications.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: ADB does not charge any application fee; check host institution fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through agents; apply directly to the designated academic institution.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial pocket money before first stipend release.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You can stay and work abroad post-graduation. (Fact: MANDATORY 2-year return to home country is legally binding under scholarship terms).
MYTH: You can apply without work experience. (Fact: Minimum 2 years of full-time professional experience is strictly required).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some agencies claim this funds PhDs; ADB-JSP strictly funds Master's degree programs.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance in accordance with host institution standards.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residence and attendance at designated host institution.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host institutions report progress annually to the Asian Development Bank.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars are not permitted to work for pay during their scholarship period.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY 2-Year Return: Scholars must agree to return to their home country for at least 2 years following completion to contribute to economic development.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Legal undertaking signed with the Asian Development Bank.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing to return home or termination of study requires repayment of all scholarship benefits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: No extensions beyond normal master's program duration.
